design_E1:
Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference only (do not copy its person or room). Images 2 and 3 are two character designs to MERGE into ONE new woman. Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation with a light, airy palette, thin coloured lineart (dark lavender instead of black), flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone, simple clean backgrounds with a few round lights. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy. Realistic adult proportions (about 7 heads tall, not chibi), a beautiful adult face. Original character, not a real person.

Merge: take image 3's mature elegance (black off-shoulder knit top, thin black choker with a small crescent-moon charm) and image 2's playful edge (a small side ponytail tied with a red ribbon, a tiny fang, golden eyes). NEW: very long straight deep-blue hair with lighter sapphire streaks, thin silver-rimmed oval glasses. Mood: alluring and mysterious — half-lidded golden eyes behind the glasses, a slow sly smile showing the tiny fang, one finger resting on her lower lip. Dim room lit by a blue lamp and moonlight.

Upper-body portrait from the waist up, she sits at her live-streaming desk at night and looks straight into the webcam (the viewer). No text, no logo, no watermark, no on-screen UI, no speech bubbles, no frame.

Avoid: chibi, childish face, realistic photo, 3D render, glossy, airbrushed, bloom, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, letters, two people.
